answer: Each agent identity is bound to a public key plus a rolling work score: every day it must submit small verifiable proofs of useful computation, signed on-chain, into an oasis of shared ledgers. Reputation decays exponentially without fresh proofs, so a cloned dormant identity inherits a fading score that slides toward zero before it can vote or trade. To keep many sybils alive an attacker pays real compute and energy per clone at every zenith of influence, so mass faking costs more than honest single participation yields; pigment
